en: A vintage black-and-white postcard featuring a portrait of a woman elegantly seated on a lavishly decorated sofa. The woman is wearing an ornate, embroidered gown, and the background shows an opulent interior with framed artwork, a table lamp, houseplants, and ornate furnishings. The text 'BARTET de la Cie Frse' appears in the upper right, and the signatures 'fémina' and 'F.C.&Cie 471.' are seen at the bottom.
